notes.title: Fixed movement and lock-on issues.
notes.notes:
・Fixed an issue where you couldn't run when moving diagonally.
・Fixed an issue where the character continued moving even after the joystick was released.
・Fixed issues with lock on.

notes.title: Update on Player Character Movement
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has purchased the game.
In this update, I’ve implemented a system that switches between walking and running animations based on the player’s movement. The character’s motion now feels a bit smoother.
I hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Change to game clear conditions.
notes.notes:
There has been one change to the conditions for clearing the game.
If you defeat 15 or more marked enemies, collect 15 or more hidden gems, and successfully complete 15 or more quests, a boss will appear in the field. You cannot clear the game unless you defeat this boss. Defeating this boss is now one of the conditions for clearing the game.

notes.title: Fixed bugs related to clearing the game
notes.notes:
The problem has been fixed in the current version.
You can now clear the game by defeating 25 targets, collecting 25 gems, completing 20 or more quests, and going to the obelisk on the field.
